messages:
sam: deploy-bot reported canary failure for auth-service chart v4.0.0 in ap-south — post-install job CrashLoopBackOff and pods ImagePullBackOff at 10% canary. tagging @anika @sre-oncall. should we pin back or wait for artifact?
deploy-bot: Canary halted at 10%. Pod event: Failed to pull image "registry.internal/auth-service:4.0.0" — manifest unknown. (bot)
anika: looks like the release pipeline promoted chart 4.0.0 before the registry mirror finished. CI shows image push succeeded to primary registry but regional mirror still returning 404.
liam: ah, I saw the mirror job spike errors earlier. mirror job retry queue backed up for ~12m. by the time promotion ran the digest wasn't present in ap-south.
sre-oncall: options: 1) wait for mirror to converge (could be 10-30m), 2) rollback the canary to 3.9.8 and pin promotion manifest for ap-south, 3) hotpatch values to point to the previous image tag (ugly and risky). I'd prefer 2 if we need stability.
sam: agreed. waiting 30m risks user-facing failures. rollback via deploy-bot is quick. Also we should prevent cross-region promotion while pinned.
anika: confirm no schema/CRD changes between 3.9.8 and 4.0.0 that would block rollback? I checked changelog — only feature flags and a minor job addition that runs as postinstall (non-destructive). rollback safe.
liam: I'll prepare the pin PR for the promotion manifest so the pipeline won't try 4.0.0 again for ap-south: https://git.company/releases/props/pulls/2100 (WIP).
sam: command if we need to force rollback: `deploy-bot promote --chart auth-service:3.9.8 --region ap-south --force-rollback && deploy-bot pin --chart auth-service:3.9.8 --region ap-south`
release-bot: Draft note added: "Roll back auth-service to v3.9.8 in ap-south due to missing regional image for v4.0.0. Action: pin region, investigate registry mirror, re-promote when digest available."
anika: we'll also add a short playbook step to check registry mirror status before promotion. Suggest `regmirrorctl status --region ap-south --image registry.internal/auth-service:4.0.0` as a pre-promotion gate. Filing infra follow-up: https://git.company/infra/issues/901
liam: PR for pin created and CI passing for manifest lint. merging now and will trigger rollback once merged.
sam: merge done. initiating rollback to 3.9.8 now.
deploy-bot: Promotion executed: auth-service promoted to 3.9.8 in ap-south (forced rollback). Canary at 10% -> steady.
sre-oncall: monitoring — image for 3.9.8 pulls fine, postinstall job completes. 5xxs returned to baseline.
anika: publish release note update and mention follow-up to add registry mirror check to promotion CI.
release-bot: Release notes updated with rollback blurb and incident timeline.
liam: after action: we should add a pre-promotion check that asserts the manifest digest exists in every target registry/mirror before advancing. I'll add a ticket: https://git.company/infra/issues/902
sam: closing loop: once mirror backlog clears we'll re-open promotion for 4.0.0 in ap-south with the same canary plan and the new gating in place. ETA for re-promote: after mirror confirmation.
anika: noted. thanks all, nice quick decision. :white_check_mark:
